tools.name: email_broadcasts_preview
tools.description: Counts sendable, unsubscribed, and suppressed recipients for broadcast `broadcast_id` without sending mail. Optional `audience` overrides the saved audience for this count.

mode.description: filter: members matching every filter. pick: chosen users and addresses. newsletter: confirmed subscribers of list_id.

items.description: Company role: owner, staff, or member.

access.description: Account access to match: enabled, disabled, or any.

seen_before.description: ISO date, inclusive. Never-seen users match.

emails.description: Addresses outside the directory. They get the main language.

tools.name: email_broadcasts_send
tools.description: Queues delivery of broadcast `broadcast_id` to its audience through the company bulk sender, and returns the broadcast state. A broadcast that cannot be sent returns 409.

tools.name: email_cancel_messages
tools.description: Cancels queued or retrying message `message_id`, clears stored variables, and returns the id and status cancelled. A message that already left the queue returns 409 message_not_cancellable.

tools.name: email_create_action_rules
tools.description: Creates a Shellui Actions webhook rule for `event_type`, `name`, and HTTPS `url`, and returns the rule with `secret` masked. Read the plaintext secret from the HTTP API, not from this tool.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

event_type.description: Shellui Actions event id this rule receives.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives the signed webhook.

newsletter_id.description: email.newsletter.* rules only: only events of this list. Null or 0 clears it.

tools.name: email_create_broadcasts
tools.description: Creates a broadcast draft named `name` from library `source_key`, with optional `language` and `audience`, and returns the draft including its id and template_id.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

language.description: Main language of the content, en or fr. Default en.

mode.description: filter: members matching every filter. pick: chosen users and addresses. newsletter: confirmed subscribers of list_id.

items.description: Company role: owner, staff, or member.

access.description: Account access to match: enabled, disabled, or any.

seen_before.description: ISO date, inclusive. Never-seen users match.

emails.description: Addresses outside the directory. They get the main language.

tools.name: email_create_library
tools.description: Creates a company library design from `name`, or copies one when `source_id` is set. Returns the new design, including its id and rendered HTML.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

source_id.description: Library template to duplicate. Create only.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. A duplicate keeps its source's when omitted.

tools.name: email_create_newsletters
tools.description: Creates a newsletter list named `name`, with its confirmation template and sign-up URL, and returns the list including its id and public_key.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_create_newsletters_subscribers
tools.description: Adds `email` to newsletter `newsletter_id` and returns the outcome and subscriber. `mode` confirm sends a confirmation email, and consented records an existing opt-in without mail.

language.description: en or fr. Omit to use the list default.

mode.description: confirm (default) sends the confirmation email. consented adds the address as confirmed.

tools.name: email_create_rules
tools.description: Creates an email rule for `event_type`, a template copy from `content.library_id`, and the first published version. Returns the rule, including its id, recipients, and template_id.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

service.description: Owner service for event_type. Omit to use the catalog service. A mismatch returns event_unknown.

event_type.description: Catalog event id. Auth-lane events are rejected.

recipient_mode.description: hints uses addresses on the event. static uses static_recipients.

language.description: en or fr. Omit to use the catalog default.

newsletter_id.description: `email.newsletter.*` rules only: one newsletter list, or null for every list.

content.description: Template the rule sends. `library_id` is required.

library_id.description: Library template the event copy starts from.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. Used when the library template has none.

tools.name: email_create_suppressions
tools.description: Blocks future mail to `email` for the lanes in `lanes` (every lane when omitted) and returns the new suppression id and masked address. `reason` defaults to manual.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

reason.description: Why the address is blocked. Default manual.

lanes.description: Lanes to block. Omit or send an empty list to block every lane.

items.description: One delivery lane: auth, transactional, or bulk.

tools.name: email_create_template_versions
tools.description: Creates a draft version of template `template_id` from the latest version, or from `library_id` when that is sent. Returns the new version number and state draft.

translations.description: Other languages of the copy. Kept from the latest version when omitted; a start over keeps their subjects only.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. Kept from the latest version when omitted. A start over takes the library template's, if it has one.

library_id.description: Start over from this library template. Subject and preheader stay unless sent.

tools.name: email_delete_action_rules
tools.description: Deletes Shellui Actions webhook rule `rule_id` and returns an empty result. A delivery already in flight may still finish.

tools.name: email_delete_broadcasts
tools.description: Deletes broadcast draft `broadcast_id` and its template copy, and returns an empty result. A broadcast that is sending or already sent returns 409 broadcast_not_deletable.

tools.name: email_delete_library
tools.description: Deletes the company library design `library_id` when no rule or copy uses it, and returns an empty result. A design still in use returns 409 template_in_use.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_delete_newsletters
tools.description: Deletes newsletter list `newsletter_id`, its subscribers, and its confirmation template, and returns an empty result.

tools.name: email_delete_newsletters_subscribers
tools.description: Deletes subscriber `subscriber_id` from newsletter `newsletter_id` so the address can sign up again, and returns an empty result.

tools.name: email_delete_rules
tools.description: Deletes a company email rule `rule_id` and its template copy, and returns an empty result. Built-in auth rules cannot be deleted.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_delete_suppressions
tools.description: Deletes suppression `suppression_id` so the address can receive mail again, and returns an empty result.

tools.name: email_delete_templates
tools.description: Deletes template copy `template_id` when no rule or broadcast uses it, and returns an empty result. A copy still in use returns 409 template_in_use.

template_id.description: Internal template copy id from list or rule responses.

tools.name: email_export_newsletter_subscribers
tools.description: Returns subscribers of newsletter `newsletter_id` as CSV text in `csv`, with content_type text/csv. Optional `status` limits the export.

status.description: Subscriber status. Omit to return every status.

tools.name: email_get_action_deliveries
tools.description: Returns Shellui Actions delivery `delivery_id`, including attempts, HTTP statuses, and the signed envelope.

tools.name: email_get_action_event_log
tools.description: Returns one domain event log row `event_id`, including the full event payload.

tools.name: email_get_action_event_log_retention
tools.description: Returns how many days this company keeps domain event log rows.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_get_action_rules
tools.description: Returns Shellui Actions webhook rule `rule_id`, including URL and enabled state. The signing secret is masked.

tools.name: email_get_auth_link_hosts
tools.description: Returns the company auth-link host allowlist plus platform and application hosts used to validate magic-link URLs in templates.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_get_broadcasts
tools.description: Returns broadcast `broadcast_id`, including audience, template, counts, state, and sender configuration.

tools.name: email_get_catalog
tools.description: Returns the Shellui catalog events a company can edit, with variables, suggested subjects, and default designs. Built-in auth events that companies cannot edit are omitted.

tools.name: email_get_library
tools.description: Returns one library design for `library_id`, including the editor document, theme, variables, and rendered HTML.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_get_messages
tools.description: Returns message `message_id`, including lane, provider, status timeline, and template key. The recipient address is not included.

tools.name: email_get_newsletters
tools.description: Returns newsletter list `newsletter_id`, including settings, Turnstile flags, subscriber counts, and sign-up URL.

tools.name: email_get_provider
tools.description: Returns this company's mail provider, from addresses, and whether credentials are set. Secrets and passwords are not included.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_get_rules
tools.description: Returns email rule `rule_id`, including recipients, enabled state, language, and template_id.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_get_stats
tools.description: Returns delivery counts for this company by day, lane, and event type. Optional `from` and `to` are ISO dates, and `lane` and `event_type` filter the window.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

lane.description: Delivery lane: auth, transactional, or bulk.

to.description: End of the window, inclusive, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: email_get_template_versions
tools.description: Returns version `version_number` of template `template_id`, including document, translations, theme, and publish state.

tools.name: email_get_templates
tools.description: Returns metadata for template copy `template_id`, including template_key, kind, language, and active_version. Editor JSON is on the version tools.

template_id.description: Internal template copy id from list or rule responses.

tools.name: email_import_newsletter_subscribers
tools.description: Imports subscribers into newsletter `newsletter_id` from CSV text in `csv`, and returns counts of added, existing, invalid, and skipped rows. `mode` confirm emails each new address, and consented marks them confirmed without mail.

csv.description: CSV text with an email column, and optional first_name and language.

mode.description: confirm (default) emails each new address. consented marks them confirmed without mail.

tools.name: email_list_action_deliveries
tools.description: Returns recent Shellui Actions webhook deliveries for this company, with status, attempt counts, and last error.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_action_event_log
tools.description: Returns recent email domain events stored for this company, including event_type, data, and created_at.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_action_event_log_types
tools.description: Returns the Shellui Actions event type ids that are valid for log filters and webhook rules.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_action_events
tools.description: Returns Shellui Actions event ids a webhook rule can subscribe to, with a label and description for each.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_action_rules
tools.description: Returns this company's Shellui Actions webhook rules. Signing secrets are masked.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_broadcasts
tools.description: Returns this company's broadcast drafts and sent campaigns, with audience summary and delivery counts.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_library
tools.description: Returns built-in Shellui designs and this company's library templates, grouped by set. Each row includes the name, subject, and rendered HTML.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_messages
tools.description: Returns recent outbound messages for this company, with masked recipients and status. Optional filters are `status`, `lane`, `template_key`, and `limit` (default 50, max 200).

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

lane.description: Delivery lane: auth, transactional, or bulk.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return. Default 50, maximum 200.

tools.name: email_list_newsletters
tools.description: Returns this company's newsletter lists, with public keys, subscriber counts, and sign-up URLs.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_newsletters_subscribers
tools.description: Returns a page of subscribers for newsletter `newsletter_id`. Optional `status` filters by pending, confirmed, or unsubscribed, and `email` looks up one address.

status.description: Subscriber status. Omit to return every status.

tools.name: email_list_rules
tools.description: Returns this company's email rules, each binding an event_type to a template and recipients, with optional `service` to limit by catalog service. Built-in auth rules are included and cannot be deleted or disabled.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

service.description: Catalog service that owns the event, such as hosting or email.

tools.name: email_list_suppressions
tools.description: Returns this company's suppressed addresses, masked, with reason and lanes.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_list_template_versions
tools.description: Returns every draft and published version of template `template_id`, including document, translations, theme, and state.

tools.name: email_list_templates
tools.description: Returns this company's event and broadcast template copies. Optional `event_type` limits the list to one catalog event.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

event_type.description: Catalog event id. An unknown id returns event_unknown.

tools.name: email_publish_template_versions
tools.description: Publishes draft `version_number` of template `template_id` after link and placeholder checks, and sets it as active_version. Returns the version number, state, and checksum.

tools.name: email_render_preview_templates
tools.description: Renders HTML and plain text for template `template_id` with placeholders filled, and does not send mail. Omit `document` to use the newest draft, or send `document` and `variables` to preview unsaved JSON.

number.description: Version number. Default: newest draft, else the active published version.

document.description: Unsaved editor JSON. When sent, `subject` is required unless the version supplies it.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. Used with `document`.

variables.description: Placeholder map for `{{ token }}` values. Omitted keys use catalog examples where available.

tools.name: email_replace_auth_link_hosts
tools.description: Replaces the company auth-link host allowlist with `hosts`, and returns the saved hosts plus platform and application hosts. Removing a host makes template links on that host fail checks.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_replace_library
tools.description: Updates name, subject, preheader, document, or theme on the company library design `library_id`, and returns the saved design. Built-in Shellui designs reject the write.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

source_id.description: Library template to duplicate. Create only.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. A duplicate keeps its source's when omitted.

tools.name: email_replace_provider
tools.description: Replaces this company's mail provider (`resend`, `ses`, or `smtp`), from addresses, and credentials, and returns the saved settings without secrets. Omitted optional fields keep their stored values.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

provider.description: Sending provider: resend, ses, or smtp.

secret_access_key.description: Amazon SES secret access key. Write-only.

region.description: Amazon SES region. Defaults to eu-central-2.

tools.name: email_requeue_action_deliveries
tools.description: Queues another attempt for failed or dead Shellui Actions delivery `delivery_id`, and returns the delivery with status pending.

tools.name: email_rotate_newsletter_key
tools.description: Issues a new public_key for newsletter `newsletter_id` and returns the list. Sign-up URLs that still use the old key stop working.

tools.name: email_rotate_rule_secret
tools.description: Replaces the signing secret on Shellui Actions webhook rule `rule_id` and returns the rule with `secret` masked. The previous secret stops verifying immediately.

tools.name: email_send_test_rule
tools.description: Queues a sample Shellui Actions delivery to the URL on rule `rule_id`, and returns status queued. This sends an HTTPS webhook, not email.

tools.name: email_send_test_templates
tools.description: Queues one test message for template `template_id` to the caller address, or to `to` when the caller is Shellui staff, and returns the provider send status. Use render preview when you only need HTML.

theme.description: Colors that repaint a library design: {name, label, colors: {role: "#rrggbb"}}. Roles: background, foreground, card, muted, muted_foreground, primary, primary_foreground, border. {} keeps the design's own colors. Used with document.

tools.name: email_test_send_provider
tools.description: Queues one test message through the saved provider to the caller address, or to `to` when the caller is Shellui staff, and returns the provider status. Missing credentials return 400 provider_not_configured.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

tools.name: email_update_action_rules
tools.description: Updates name, description, enabled, URL, or newsletter filter on Shellui Actions webhook rule `rule_id`, and returns the saved rule.

newsletter_id.description: email.newsletter.* rules only: only events of this list. Null or 0 clears it.

tools.name: email_update_broadcasts
tools.description: Updates `name` or `audience` on broadcast draft `broadcast_id`, and returns the saved broadcast. A broadcast that has started sending returns 409 broadcast_not_editable.

mode.description: filter: members matching every filter. pick: chosen users and addresses. newsletter: confirmed subscribers of list_id.

items.description: Company role: owner, staff, or member.

access.description: Account access to match: enabled, disabled, or any.

seen_before.description: ISO date, inclusive. Never-seen users match.

emails.description: Addresses outside the directory. They get the main language.

tools.name: email_update_newsletters
tools.description: Updates name, description, language, origins, redirect URL, or Turnstile keys on newsletter `newsletter_id`, and returns the saved list. `turnstile_secret` is write-only.

tools.name: email_update_rules
tools.description: Updates `enabled`, `recipient_mode`, `static_recipients`, `language`, or `newsletter_id` on email rule `rule_id`, and returns the saved rule. Built-in auth rules reject changes to enabled or recipients.

company_id.description: Target company. Company owners omit this when the JWT already includes `company_id`. Shellui staff may set it to manage another company.

recipient_mode.description: hints uses addresses on the event. static uses static_recipients.

language.description: en or fr. Omit to leave the saved language.

newsletter_id.description: `email.newsletter.*` rules only: one newsletter list, or null for every list.
